requiredFacts.unknownPolicy: Any missing, null, uncertain, conflicting or unsupported required fact stops the affected transition; do not derive actual received amount or currency from invoice totals or assume new business from an empty database.

originBoundary.firstCashIssue: Explicit owner review includes facts outside the workspace; cross-check actual accounting and issuance history is empty before this first qualifying issue. Drafts and retained unposted evidence alone do not prove or disprove new-business origin.
originBoundary.continuation: Later issues and receipts can use a proven immutable qualifying origin and uninterrupted eligible cash history; do not require the workspace to remain empty or relabel valid cash continuation as legacy. Unknown or mixed history cannot be grandfathered.
originBoundary.profileBoundary: Identity-only cash issuance freezes method ambiguity even before a first voucher; current profile changes cannot reprice, retime or replace issued method/case proof.

receiptEvidenceBoundary.verification: Verify retained PDF content, workspace association and byte integrity; reject generated invoice PDFs as bank evidence. Preserve received source plus explicit owner additions without rewriting the source.
receiptEvidenceBoundary.authenticationClaim: Byte integrity plus explicit owner data is NOT bank authentication, OCR or bank-format validation.
receiptEvidenceBoundary.entryIdentity: Require explicit bank ID, receiving-account reference and actual transaction reference sufficient to trace one actual full receipt. Do not generate identity from the invoice or file metadata. A PDF may contain several entries, but this first slice may consume its content hash for only one cash receipt.
receiptEvidenceBoundary.duplicateBoundary: One bank/account/transaction identity cannot fund two invoices or be recognized again under another key or PDF. One retained PDF content hash can fund only one cash receipt, even when typed identities differ or the statement contains other real entries. Exact completed replay is recovery, not another consumption. Do not advise editing the source or inventing references to bypass either reservation.
receiptEvidenceBoundary.replayBoundary: Exact durable result recovery creates zero additional vouchers, lines or source consumption and preserves original identity/stage/proof. Changed invoice, date, amount, currency, source entry or facts are not a cached success. A cached result must not authorize a new mutation or hide missing/tampered evidence as verified receipt proof; historical inspection is distinct from new recognition.
